name: perch
description: Un compagnon pixelise qui vit sur le bureau, se perche au bord des fenetres et grandit avec votre facon d'utiliser la machine.

scripts.pack:fetch: node scripts/pack-fetch.mjs && npm run typecheck && node scripts/validate-pack.mjs
scripts.health: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run lint:length && npm run typecheck && npm run deps && npm run dead && npm run test
scripts.dist:win: npm run typecheck && npm run assets --workspace @perch/app && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run typecheck && npm run assets --workspace @perch/app && electron-builder --linux --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.visual: npm run typecheck && npm run assets --workspace @perch/app && electron scripts/visual-check.cjs --ozone-platform=x11
scripts.visual:choix: npm run typecheck && npm run assets --workspace @perch/app && electron scripts/chooser-check.cjs --ozone-platform=x11
scripts.demo:record: npm run typecheck && npm run assets --workspace @perch/app && electron scripts/record-demo.cjs --ozone-platform=x11
